import trimesh, numpy as np
lid = trimesh.load('exports/model.lid.6029fe16.stl')
for y in [0.0, 2.0]:
    o = np.array([[50.0, y, 10.0]])
    d = np.array([[-1.0, 0.0, 0.0]])
    locs, ir, it = lid.ray.intersects_location(o, d)
    xs = sorted([float(p[0]) for p in locs], reverse=True) if len(locs)>0 else []
    print('y=', y, 'hits x:', [round(v,3) for v in xs])
